breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that Va = W1·cos(β1) and then states W2 must be adjusted to satisfy the constant axial velocity condition (Va = W2·cos(β2)), rather than using the inconsistent given value of W2=100 m/s. This matches the ground truth approach of recalculating W2 = Va/cos(β2).
